name: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited
court: independent adversarial court, 2026-08-03 pre-market; generator = quality_drawdown screen (generator-never-grades-itself invariant holds); score 2/10 so no red team required
verdict: FRAME-REJECT 2/10 — the drawdown IS the gold price; a 1.3-1.5x levered gold-beta position wearing a quality-drawdown costume

frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.question: is the -41.4% drawdown simply the gold price?
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.answer: YES — 85-100%+ of it, and the residual is not statistically identified
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.blowoff_top: 2026-01-30 one-day break: gold -11.4%, SLV -28.5%. Classic parabolic bubble break. AEM -11.6% same day (beta ~1.0)
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.aem_peak_is_the_gold_double_top: AEM 3y high 251.57 on 2026-03-02, when gold closed 5294 = 99.5% of its all-time high. The screen's 3y-high anchor IS the commodity bubble peak.
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.regression_from_aem_peak: pre-peak 2y daily beta to GLD = 1.30 (R2 0.58); beta-explains -30.2% of the -41.4%; residual -16.0%; 1sd tracking error +/-15.3pp so z = -1.14, NOT significant
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.start_date_sweep: residual vs gold across all 41 business-day start dates 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-16 ranges +3.4% to -17.0%, median -8.3%. A +/-20pp swing from a 6-week choice of start date = the residual is a start-date artifact, not a finding.

start_date_free_level_tests.aem_over_gold_ratio_percentile: 87th pctile of 10y, 79th of 5y, 65th of 3y — AEM is near a DECADE HIGH versus the metal, i.e. it has NOT de-rated vs gold at all
start_date_free_level_tests.aem_over_gdx_ratio_percentile: 74th pctile of 10y, 60th of 5y — not cheap vs its own sector either
start_date_free_level_tests.cycle_to_date: from 2024-12-31: AEM +92% vs gold +56%, GDX +126%, SPY +31% — AEM has BEATEN the metal over the cycle and still trades up hugely

frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.aem_vs_gdx_residual: median -5.2pp across the start-date sweep (range -1.1 to -10.3pp) — a small, real sector-relative lag, explicable by Malartic + the capex raise
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.independent_cross_check_margin_leverage: gold 5294 -> 4108 against TCC ~1070 gives cash margin -28.1%; against AISC ~1475 gives -31.1%. So ~30 of the 41 points of drawdown are the earnings decline, ~11 is modest multiple compression off a bubble multiple. Converges with the regression via a completely different method.
frame_test_gold_beta_decomposition.conclusion: There is no material non-gold residual. The house's PHYS sleeve already expresses gold; AEM would import the same factor at 1.3-1.5x leverage plus operational, jurisdictional and capital-allocation risk, at a gold-relative valuation in the 87th decile.

mode_b_findings.finding: GROWTH-CLAIM INVERSION — the screen's quality evidence is a commodity price in disguise, and volumes are FALLING
mode_b_findings.claim: screen row: rev +35%, earnings +49%, op margin 58%
mode_b_findings.authority: Q2-2026 MD&A (6-K acc 0001104659-26-088216, ex-99.1), AISC reconciliation table
mode_b_findings.result: H1-2026 gold production 1,680,925 oz vs H1-2025 1,739,823 oz = -3.4%. Q2-26 855,816 oz vs Q2-25 866,029 oz = -1.2%. MD&A attributes the revenue rise to a +51.2% realized gold price. 100%+ of the 'growth' is price; volume declined.
mode_b_findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — the growth metric is a contra-indicator, since the price driving it has since fallen 22.8%. op margin 58% is peak-cycle at a $4,672/oz realized price.

mode_b_findings.finding: FORWARD P/E 11.7 IS A STALE-CONSENSUS ARTIFACT
mode_b_findings.authority: consensus EPS trend + revision breadth; AEM H1-2026 actuals; live spot gold
mode_b_findings.result: FY27 consensus EPS 12.56 today vs 14.45 thirty days ago vs 14.84 sixty days ago (-15%, still falling). Revision breadth last 30d: 0 up / 5 down — unanimous. Q3-26 consensus 2.92 vs 3.65 sixty days ago (-20%). Spot-flat model: H1-26 adj EPS 6.48 annualizes to 12.96 at realized $4,672; sensitivity ~$0.47/sh per $100/oz (triangulated 3 ways: Q1->Q2 empirical 0.51, structural 0.46, implied-beta consistent); spot $4,108 is -$564 => -$2.65 => $10.31; less Malartic -150koz 2027 (-$0.55) plus Detour/Odyssey ramp (+$0.3-0.5) => FY27 spot-flat EPS ~$10.0-10.3.
mode_b_findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — real forward P/E at FLAT SPOT GOLD is ~14.5x, not 11.7x (understated ~24%). Consensus FY27 of 12.56 implies gold ~$4,620, i.e. +12.5% above spot.

mode_b_findings.finding: P/E LOOKS NORMAL PRECISELY BECAUSE EARNINGS ARE PEAK-CYCLE
mode_b_findings.authority: AEM annual EPS history + gold long-run levels
mode_b_findings.result: AEM P/E history 13.2x (2023), 20.6x (2024), 19.1x (2025) — so 14.5x is not expensive on P/E. But spot gold $4,108 is +58% vs its own 5y average and +125% vs the 2020-23 average. A normal multiple on a commodity-peak denominator.
mode_b_findings.verdict: CONFIRMED — GARP growth-trap mode 2 (peak earnings). The gold-relative test (87th pctile) is the robust one because it is not contaminated by the earnings cycle.

cause_check_of_the_sector_relative_lag.barnat_pit_rock_mass_movement: 2026-07-01, north wall of the Barnat open pit at Canadian Malartic (Quebec). No injuries, equipment damage or environmental impact. Mining suspended as a precaution; remediation completes Q3-2026, mining resumes Q4-2026. Plant fed low-grade stockpile in the interim. Impact: -60,000 to -80,000 oz in H2-2026 and up to -150,000 oz in EACH of 2027 and 2028. Malartic FY26 TCC to ~$1,260 from $1,187.
cause_check_of_the_sector_relative_lag.timing_disqualifies_it_as_the_de_rate_ca: the event is 2026-07-01; AEM had already fallen from 251.57 (Mar-2) to ~155 (Jun-30). It caused none of the drawdown.
cause_check_of_the_sector_relative_lag.magnitude: ~370koz cumulative (H2-26 + 2027 + 2028) x ~$2,600/oz AISC margin = ~$960M pretax, ~$670M after tax = ~0.9% of the $74.6B cap. AEM lost ~$7.3B of relative value vs GDX from Mar-2. The sector-relative move over-prices Malartic several times over, or is mostly noise.
cause_check_of_the_sector_relative_lag.meadowbank: H1-2026 production -11.6% on lower mining-sequence grades; production cost/oz $1,494 in Q2-26 vs $1,040 in Q2-25. Real single-mine cost pressure, absorbed within consolidated guidance.
cause_check_of_the_sector_relative_lag.no_derailment: guidance maintained, TCC inside range, net cash up, credit upgraded. This is neither a de-rate nor a derailment — it is a COMMODITY RE-PRICE.

honesty_channel.item: AISC / total cash costs / minesite cost per tonne composition revised effective 2026-01-01 to adjust out the NTI Payment (net-profits royalty to Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. under the Amaruq mineral production lease at Meadowbank), on the reasoning it resembles the Crown royalty which IFRS treats as income tax. Affects Meadowbank, the Nunavut region and the CONSOLIDATED company number.
honesty_channel.size: the 'In-kind royalty and NTI Payments' line is $24/oz in Q2-26 against consolidated TCC of $1,054/oz — roughly 2%
honesty_channel.grade: CLEAN — do not ELEVATE. AEM names the change, explains it, quantifies it in the reconciliation table, and itself discloses that it deviates from World Gold Council 2018 guidance. The timing (a cost-metric change effective in a year of cost pressure, touching the consolidated number) is worth a note, but the marketed takeaway does not diverge from the data. This is the honestly-disclosed case the doctrine says to leave alone.

fv_scenarios.the_point: at flat spot gold, fair value EQUALS the live price. There is no valuation edge independent of a gold call — the frame reject expressed in dollars.
fv_scenarios.street_target_mean: $214.62 (14 analysts) = the bull case, i.e. targets are still marked to ~$5,000 gold and lagging the tape

four_idea_frame.edge: NO — no informational or analytical advantage over a $75B mega-cap with 15+ analysts; the only live variable is gold
four_idea_frame.risk_premium: PARTIAL — ~14.5x spot-flat earnings for levered gold beta on an A- balance sheet is fairly paid, but the driver is a single UNBOUNDED undiversifiable factor, not a bounded one
four_idea_frame.diligence: YES — the diligence found the inverse of the pitch (gold-relative valuation at a decade high, volumes shrinking, estimates falling unanimously). The rejection is the product.

gfi_same_ruling: Gold Fields sits just below the generator's cut and gets the SAME frame reject, harder. GFI's residual vs gold across start dates is -3.1% to +2.9% — nil; the entire -43.2% is beta 1.7-1.9 applied to the gold break. GFI/gold ratio sits at the 91st percentile of 10y and 82nd of 5y — even MORE extended versus the metal than AEM. And it is the lower-quality vehicle: net DEBT ~$1.44B (vs AEM net cash $3.27B), EV/EBITDA 11.5x (vs AEM 7.4x at spot), South Africa / Ghana / Peru jurisdiction versus AEM's Canada / Australia / Finland, and its own estimates being cut (FY26 $5.69 -> $5.01). Its 'fwd P/E 6.3' is the same stale-consensus artifact, worse. Do not promote above the cut.
generator_defects_owed_as_code: P1 — quality_drawdown has NO factor-beta gate. 'Drawdown from 3y high' is not a de-rate signal when the 3y high is a commodity blowoff top. Fix: before scoring, regress the name on its dominant factor (gold/oil/copper/rates) over a pre-peak window and require the factor-residual drawdown to clear a floor (~15pp) with |z|>1 on a START-DATE-SWEPT basis, never a single peak date.
P1 — fwd P/E must be recomputed at SPOT factor levels for commodity producers. Flag any name whose consensus has been cut >10% in 60 days with zero up-revisions as STALE before it can score.
P2 — 'rev +X% / earnings +Y%' must be volume-decomposed for commodity producers. AEM printed +35% revenue growth on -3.4% volume; the screen read a falling commodity price's echo as quality growth.
